licence_contradiction.verdict: CONFIRMED by direct API listing. A benchmark asking others to cite it, with no LICENSE file, resolves to NOASSERTION regardless of the card tag. Fix: add LICENSE (Apache-2.0) to the repo — the card tag alone does not license anything.
